verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an official llms.txt at imagemagick.org/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with structured content: a tagline, canonical URL, and an integration description. An agent can be pointed at it directly. However, the markdown variant of the docs pages returns 404, and nothing shows how deep the llms.txt content goes. Missing for 10: markdown/agent-oriented versions of the full docs pages, evidence of comprehensive llms.txt coverage (e.g., an llms-full.txt or command reference), and independent corroboration of agent use.
